_meta.gameVersion: Mixed. Cradle override texts = OHDB (oncehumandb.com) scrape mirrored in github.com/saitoh183/once-human-build-planner (2026; contains v1.0 legacy, v1.4+ general, scenario-tag and unscaled datamine variants side by side). Memetics = TKronix/Memetics-For-Dummies dataset (covers Manibus/Evolution's Call, Way of Winter and Prismverse's Clash 'Legendary Mayfly/Rosetta' paths; exact snapshot date unknown). Cross-checks: Sportskeeda v1.4 article (Jan 2025), Sep-26-2024 patch note (Sustained Suppression fix), TeeReckzi/OHMM in-game hover captures (2026-03). NOT verified against v2.3.5 (Mar 2026 Super Anomaly rework) or v3.0.6 (Sep 2026) patch notes, which were unreachable.
sources: https://www.oncehumandb.com/cradle-overrides (original data source; fetched via mirror below because the domain was blocked)
_meta.notes: Percentages are plain numbers meaning percent (15 = +15%). 'flat' unit = raw points (Accuracy +30, Reload Speed +20 are shown in-game as unitless numbers). Every override variant published by OHDB is kept (170 rows, 120 distinct names): use `pool` to pick the live one - prefer pool 'general_post_1.4' (5xxx) and 'general_unversioned' rows whose name has no 5xxx twin; 'legacy_general_1.0' (4xxx) rows are the pre-v1.4 numbers; 'datamine_placeholder' rows (1xxx/2xxx, valuesLookUnscaled=true) carry x100-unscaled numbers; 'scenario_tag_pool' rows only exist in their scenario. `effects[]` is machine-parsed from the English tooltip - stat='UNPARSED' means a number was found but its stat label could not be attributed; `condition` is the verbatim tooltip. No tier/cost data exists for overrides (tier=null, cost=null); see otherSystems.cradleRules.

cradle.maxActiveNodesEvidence: 8 slots: game8 guide ('a total of 8 cradle nodes'), saitoh183 planner README ('8 compact icon-only cradle override slots'), OHMM cradleEffectResolver.ts (cap = 8, 'game enforces cap'), moabdrabou OnceHuman-Builds README ('up to 8 Cradle Override items').

nodeUnlock.manibusEvolutionsCall: Start with 1 node when the Cradle is unlocked (Meyer's Market, Broken Delta, during 'Murmurs in the Forest'); each Great One (Monolith boss) defeated unlocks 1 more node, up to 8 (game8 468460 snippet).
nodeUnlock.wayOfWinter: Nodes unlock every 5 character levels starting at Lv 5; all 8 available by Lv 40 (game8 481150 snippet).

cradle.activationCurrencyNote: No reachable source stated what (if anything) an override costs to unlock. game8/TheNerdStash snippets only say equipped overrides can be swapped freely by dragging another override onto the node. Starchrom is the only account-wide currency mentioned near the Cradle in search results, but no snippet tied it to override purchases. Left null rather than guessed.
cradle.tiersNote: No tier/rank system for overrides found in any source; each override is a single flat perk.

otherSystems.summary: Memetic Specializations are chosen every 5 character levels from Lv 5 to Lv 50 (10 picks max). Each node offers a choice among 4 randomly generated specializations, one per branch (Building, Crafting, Gathering, Management). Unlocking 2 in the same branch grants an 'Identity' title (Building: Tinkerer, Artillery Marshal; Crafting: Machinist, Demolition Expert, Master Craftsman; Gathering: Prospector, Smelter; Management: Child of the Earth, Sparksmith, Hydro Engineer, Star Chef). Prismverse's Clash added 'Legendary Mayfly' and 'Legendary Rosetta' paths. Almost all are crafting/economy perks; the combat-relevant ones are flagged combatRelevant=true below (Psi-scaled tactical items, Gene Coherence Injection buffs, food multipliers).

otherSystems.summary: How cradle % bonuses combine with gear (community reverse-engineering, not official): every damage event is multiplied through separate additive 'buckets'. Weapon DMG% (cradle, mods, sets) is additive with other Weapon DMG% in one bucket = (1 + sum/100); Status DMG%, Elemental DMG% (per element), Attack%, keyword Factor (e.g. Burn DMG/Shrapnel DMG, additive with 'DMG Coefficient'), keyword Final DMG, target-type bonus (normal/elite/boss), Vulnerability and global Final DMG are each their own multiplicative bucket. Crit DMG and Weakspot DMG are ADDITIVE with each other inside one 'hit amplifier' bucket (weakspotCrit/body = 1 + critDMG + weakspotDMG). Burn/Power Surge/Frost Vortex scale from Psi Intensity x coefficient x (1+StatusDMG) x (1+ElementalDMG).

entries.note: cradle Weapon DMG% adds to mod/set Weapon DMG% before multiplying
additive, confirmed by OHCalc validation plan and ADR-002 ('113 Test')
e.g. Power Surge coefficient 50% of Psi (sportskeeda snippet); Frost Vortex 30% Psi/s (OHDB build copy)
